verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Ollama's CLI handles model lifecycle commands such as `ollama run`, `ollama pull` and `ollama rm`, plus a `--verbose` flag. Nothing documents CLI options for GPU layer offload or context length when loading a model. One community comment even says Ollama hides server configuration behind its own defaults, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
